evidences.caption: FILE This is a April 26, 2001 file photo of author Maeve Binchy. Binchy, one of Ireland's most popular writers who sold more than 40 million books worldwide, has died in Dublin after a brief illness, according to Irish media reports Tuesday July 31, 2012. She was 72 years old. (AP Photo/Myung Jung Kim/PA File)
